summary: Executed full backend+frontend regression for new admin panel/campaign settings integration on public preview URL. Backend suites passed 33/34 with one auth-throttle failure. Frontend admin login/settings/public console flows mostly passed: password login, visibility toggle, session persistence, stale-revision recovery, network-failure unsaved state, width overflow checks, desktop/mobile screenshots, public task/share linkage, and console focus-refresh were validated.

critical.issue: Expected brute-force lockout (6th wrong password => 429) did not trigger on public endpoint; observed six 401 responses instead.

integration_issues.issue: Could not deterministically force and observe admin initial settings-load error screen in automation (route-abort attempt did not produce expected admin-load-error state).

action_items: Investigate /api/admin/login throttle path (reserve_login_attempt / request.client.host behavior behind preview proxy) so 6th failure reliably returns 429.
Re-verify lockout using repeated wrong-password requests from same client and inspect admin_login_attempts count evolution in Mongo.
Optionally add a deterministic integration test hook for forcing admin settings load failure to fully validate UI retry state in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: Throttle likely depends on request.client.host stability; behind preview ingress it appears non-sticky, weakening brute-force protection effectiveness.

Admin security implementation is otherwise strong in tested scope: HttpOnly/Secure cookies, explicit Origin checks, stale revision protection, revocable sessions, and no secret leakage in public responses.
seed_data_creation: Created one UI claim participant (handle_key=tadm90235) for POST ON X integration test; cleaned via /app/scripts/cleanup_ui_test_agents.py (deleted_test_agents=1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Artifacts captured under /app/test_reports/artifacts/iteration_4 including admin desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844) screenshots. Campaign values were restored to backend .env defaults using /app/scripts/restore_campaign_defaults.py; confirmed like_url back to https://x.com/LastZhood after focus-refresh test rollback. Public console focus-refresh check passed (task-like-link updated after admin save + focus event).
rca of the issue: Throttle RCA (HIGH): Repro by sending six wrong-password POST /api/admin/login calls with valid Origin from the public URL. Expected: [401,401,401,401,401,429]. Actual: [401,401,401,401,401,401]. Most probable cause is identifier fragmentation from request.client.host behavior through ingress/proxy (hash key instability or varying source host), preventing count from crossing threshold for a single bucket. Mitigation: derive throttle key from a stable, trusted upstream identity (or session-independent deterministic key) and add telemetry logs for address+identifier to confirm bucket continuity.
